title: I.G.
desc: Inspector General Durga Prasad gets appointed as the head of an anti-terrorism squad. However, a revelation soon forces him to choose between his family and his duty.

title: Madraskaaran
desc: Sathya, an engineer-turned-farmer, lives peacefully in Kovilpatti with his family. His life is disrupted when he is attacked by henchmen sent by his enemy, Singam.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: Kodi
desc: Twins Kodi and Anbu have different personalities. Though one is into politics, the other is a pacifist. But a twist in the twins' fates causes one to adopt the other's life and seek revenge.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Retta Thala
desc: After a chaotic past, a young man named Kaali moves to Pondicherry with his lover, Anthre. However, Anthre's desire for luxury throws Kaali into turmoil.

title: Thuruppugulan
desc: Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.
